title: Tiny, cute hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='frameGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5c26b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c98a2e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe08a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0b03c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandBottom' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f6c25c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d98e22'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glassGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfeaff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7fc9ef' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='30' y='8' width='40' height='9' rx='4' fill='url(#frameGrad)'/>
  <rect x='33' y='9.5' width='34' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#ffeda8'/>

  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='30' y='83' width='40' height='9' rx='4' fill='url(#frameGrad)'/>
  <rect x='33' y='84.5' width='34' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#ffeda8'/>

  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M34 17 L66 17 L66 22 Q66 42 50 50 Q34 58 34 78 L34 83 L66 83 L66 78 Q66 58 50 50 Q34 42 34 22 Z'
        fill='url(#glassGrad)' stroke='#9fdcf7' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- sand in top bulb -->
  <path d='M38 21 Q38 40 50 47 Q62 40 62 21 Z' fill='url(#sandTop)'/>

  <!-- falling sand stream -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='47' width='3' height='9' fill='#ffd66e' rx='1.5'/>

  <!-- sand pile in bottom bulb -->
  <path d='M38 79 Q38 58 50 56 Q62 58 62 79 Z' fill='url(#sandBottom)'/>
  <path d='M41 79 Q42 63 50 59 Q58 63 59 79 Z' fill='#ffdf8f'/>

  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d='M39 24 Q39 40 47 47' fill='none' stroke='#eaf9ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M39 76 Q41 63 47 55' fill='none' stroke='#eaf9ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='36' y='92' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='55' y='92' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c98a2e'/>
</svg>
